jobs.title: Global Project Manager (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
You bring 5+ years of global, cross-functional project management experience within regulated industries such as MedTech, Pharma, or Diagnostics, successfully driving product development and lifecycle initiatives from scoping through budget execution. Then this is your next career step!

Tasks & Responsibilities:
• Project Implementation: Sets up and leads structures for product development and product care, including scoping, communication, timelines, resources, budgets, progress, and cost control. Creates and maintains integrated project plans, ensuring efficient team operations. Accountable for quality in risk management and lessons learned, critical path analysis, scenario creation, budgeting, and robust planning.
• Project management execution: Consistently implements project management processes including guiding and managing preparation for milestone reviews, capacity reviews, as applicable & may lead improvement initiatives. Selects and applies suitable methodologies, coaching teams in agile practices and effectively handling hybrid Agile roles.
• Goal Setting and Advisory: Establishes, measures, and reports Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), standard metrics, Objectives and Key Results (OKRs) or Outcome Based Planning (OBPs) to improve project quality, efficiency, and effectiveness. Acts as a trusted advisor, supporting holistic planning, risk management, scenario creation, and critical path analysis, serving as the single point of contact for project data.
• Risk Management and Information Support: Identifies project risks and potential impacts on budget, timeline, and scope. Proactively addresses gaps, bottlenecks, and delays, proposing solutions and communicating issues to stakeholders. Manages team information to support decision making at various levels and provides planning data for scenario analysis.
• Collaboration and Coaching: Works closely with various leads and partners to ensure optimized project delivery. Coaches team members and peers, developing new skills and providing constructive feedback. Actively contributes to team learning by recognizing areas to strengthen and exploring solutions together.

Your background:
• Bachelor Degree or basic vocational training
• You bring a minimum of 5 years experience in cross functional global project management within regulated environment, preferably life cycle management, development of Diagnostic, MedTech, pharmaceutical or food products
• You are experienced in Waterfall, Agile, SAFe and Scrum methodologies
• Experience with IT project management tools is a must (please provide examples) Google, Jira, Trello, Lucidboard
• Languages: Fluent English, German is a plus
• Competencies: Curious, structured approach, strong communication and influencing skills, analytical and critical thinking, result driven, continuous improvement mindset

descriptionByLocale.it:
Porti 5+ anni di esperienza globale, cross-funzionale di gestione del progetto all'interno di settori regolamentati come MedTech, Pharma, o Diagnostics, guidando con successo le iniziative di sviluppo del prodotto e del ciclo di vita attraverso l'esecuzione del bilancio. Allora questo è il tuo prossimo passo di carriera!

Compiti e responsabilità:
• Attuazione del progetto: Imposta e guida le strutture per lo sviluppo del prodotto e la cura del prodotto, tra cui scoping, comunicazione, tempestività, risorse, budget, progresso e controllo dei costi. Crea e mantiene piani di progetto integrati, garantendo operazioni di team efficienti. Contabile per la qualità nella gestione del rischio e lezioni apprese, analisi del percorso critico, creazione di scenari, budgeting e pianificazione robusta.
• Esecuzione della gestione del progetto: implementa coerentemente processi di gestione del progetto, tra cui guida e gestione della preparazione per le recensioni di pietre miliari, recensioni di capacità, come applicabile & può condurre iniziative di miglioramento. Seleziona e applica metodologie adatte, team di coaching in pratiche agili e gestire efficacemente i ruoli ibridi Agile.
• Impostazione degli obiettivi e consulenza: Istituzioni, misure e rapporti Indicatori delle prestazioni chiave (KPI), metriche standard, obiettivi e risultati chiave (OKRs) o Pianificazione basata sul reddito (OBPs) per migliorare la qualità del progetto, l'efficienza e l'efficacia. Agisce come consulente di fiducia, sostenendo pianificazione olistica, gestione del rischio, creazione di scenari e analisi del percorso critico, servendo come unico punto di contatto per i dati del progetto.
• Gestione del rischio e supporto dell'informazione: Identificare i rischi del progetto e i potenziali impatti sul budget, la timeline e la portata. Proattivamente affronta lacune, strozzature e ritardi, proponendo soluzioni e comunicando problemi alle parti interessate. Gestisce le informazioni del team per supportare il processo decisionale a vari livelli e fornisce dati di pianificazione per l'analisi dello scenario.
• Collaborazione e coaching: lavora a stretto contatto con vari lead e partner per garantire la consegna ottimale del progetto. Allena membri del team e colleghi, sviluppando nuove competenze e fornendo feedback costruttivi. Contribuisce attivamente all'apprendimento di squadra riconoscendo le aree per rafforzare ed esplorare insieme le soluzioni.

Il tuo sfondo:
• Laurea o formazione professionale di base
• Porti un'esperienza minima di 5 anni nella gestione del progetto globale trasversale all'interno dell'ambiente regolamentato, preferibilmente la gestione del ciclo di vita, lo sviluppo di prodotti diagnostici, farmaceutici o alimentari
• Siete esperti nelle metodologie Waterfall, Agile, SAFe e Scrum
• L'esperienza con gli strumenti di gestione dei progetti IT è un must (si prega di fornire esempi) Google, Jira, Trello, Lucidboard
• Lingue: Inglese fluente, Tedesco è un plus
• Competenze: approccio curioso, strutturato, forte capacità di comunicazione e di influenza, pensiero analitico e critico, risultato guidato, miglioramento continuo

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Vous apportez 5 ans et plus d'expérience en gestion de projet globale et interfonctionnelle dans des industries réglementées comme MedTech, Pharma ou Diagnostics, conduisant avec succès le développement de produits et des initiatives de cycle de vie de la portée à l'exécution budgétaire. Alors c'est votre prochaine étape de carrière !

Tâches et responsabilités :
• Mise en oeuvre du projet: Établit et dirige des structures pour le développement de produits et les soins de produits, y compris la détermination de la portée, la communication, les délais, les ressources, les budgets, les progrès et le contrôle des coûts. Crée et maintient des plans de projets intégrés pour assurer l'efficacité des opérations de l'équipe. Responsable de la qualité de la gestion des risques et des enseignements tirés, de l'analyse des trajectoires critiques, de la création de scénarios, de la budgétisation et d'une planification robuste.
• Exécution de la gestion de projet : Mettre en oeuvre de façon cohérente les processus de gestion de projet, notamment en guidant et en gérant la préparation aux examens des étapes, aux examens des capacités, selon le cas, et en menant des initiatives d'amélioration. Sélectionne et applique des méthodologies appropriées, entraîne des équipes dans des pratiques agiles et gère efficacement des rôles agiles hybrides.
• Établissement des objectifs et avis : Établit, mesure et rend compte des indicateurs de rendement clés (ICP), des mesures normalisées, des objectifs et des résultats clés (REO) ou de la planification axée sur les résultats (PMO) afin d'améliorer la qualité, l'efficience et l'efficacité des projets. Agir comme conseiller de confiance, appuyer la planification holistique, la gestion des risques, la création de scénarios et l'analyse de trajectoire critique, servant de point de contact unique pour les données du projet.
• Gestion des risques et soutien de l'information : Déterminer les risques du projet et les répercussions potentielles sur le budget, le calendrier et la portée. jobs.description:
In this function you will lead chemical process R&D activities to deliver safe, scalable, efficient and sustainable processes as well as drug substance material for projects in clinical development, with a focus on late stage development, leveraging internal and external CDMO capabilities.

Location: Basel

Home office: Yes, 2 days a week

Duration: 1 year/possible extension

Travel: Yes. 4 times a year - Europe or Asia (China, India)

Responsibilities:
• Lead Internal & External Chemical Process R&D activities: Direct chemical process research and development work, managing an internal team of 1–5 process chemists and/or leading external activities at contract development and manufacturing organizations (CDMOs).
• Oversee end-to-end process chemistry workflows, including synthetic route scouting, process optimization, scale-up, and support for supply activities.
• Coordinate Cross-Functional Delivery: Synchronize internal laboratory efforts with CDMO timelines to guarantee the timely, safe, and cost-effective production of active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs) and advanced intermediates
• Ensure Quality & Compliance: Deliver the target compounds following internal quality processes and according to specifications, safety standards and sustainability objectives.

Must Haves:
• PhD or Postdoctoral background in Synthetic Organic Chemistry.
• 5+ years of hands-on experience in pharmaceutical chemical process R&D, with demonstrated expertise in late-stage process development and scale-up.
• Leadership & Project Management: Proven track record of leading, mentoring, and driving project deliverables within internal process chemistry teams.
• CDMO Management: Direct experience managing external chemical development, technology transfers, and manufacturing activities at CDMOs.
• Technical & Software Proficiency: High proficiency with standard office applications alongside core chemistry tools, including chemical drawing tools, literature/patent search engines, Design of Experiments (DoE) applications, analytical software, and project planning platforms. Proficiency in the use of kinetic modeling or scale-up simulation software is a plus.

Job profile
• Life Sciences - R&D Clinical
• Basel-Stadt
• Contracting
• Part Time, 100%
• Immediately - 1 year/possible extension
• Research and Development, CDMO Management, Organic Chemistry

jobs.title: Product Manager Martech (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
As a Product Manager you are the end-to-end champion of our marketing technology solutions. This hybrid role is responsible for the entire product lifecycle—from defining the long-term vision and market strategy ("The What") to leading the tactical execution and sprint delivery ("The How"). You will serve as the single point of accountability, ensuring that our Martech stack is strategically aligned with business goals while maintaining a high-velocity, high-quality development output.

Tasks & Responsibilities:

Strategic Leadership & Roadmapping
• Vision & Strategy: Define and communicate the product vision and long-term roadmap for our Martech ecosystem.
• Market Analysis: Conduct research on marketing trends, API integrations, and the competitive landscape to ensure product-market fit.
• Business Alignment: Partner with the Business Owner to ensure the product delivers measurable ROI and supports the company’s broader financial objectives.

Tactical Execution & Delivery
• Backlog & Sprint Management: Own the end-to-end backlog; draft, refine, and prioritize user stories to ensure the development team has a clear path for every sprint.
• Agile Facilitation: Lead sprint planning, define sprint goals, and participate in daily stand-ups to unblock the Scrum team and ensure timely increments.
• Functional Specifications: Translate marketing requirements into clear technical specifications.

Stakeholder & Team Orchestration
• Cross-Functional Bridge: Serve as the primary liaison between Marketing/Sales stakeholders and the technical development team.
• Quality Assurance: Validate that every product increment meets the "Definition of Done" and fulfills the strategic intent established in the roadmap.

Must Haves:
• Minimum Bachelor's degree in a relevant field
• Previous experience in marketing platforms and product ownership
• Minimum 5 year of experience within Martech
• Dual-Competency Expertise: Proven ability to balance high-level strategic thinking with meticulous, detail-oriented execution in an Agile environment.
• Martech Domain Knowledge: Strong understanding of the marketing technology landscape and data privacy regulations (GDPR/CCPA).
• Agile Mastery: Expert-level experience with Scrum frameworks, backlog grooming, and product management software.
• Technical Literacy: Ability to discuss API capabilities, data schemas, and system architecture with engineers while explaining business value to business leaders.
• Analytical Mindset: Strong capability to use data and customer insights to make prioritization decisions.
• Language Skills: Fluency in English required, German is a plus

• Marketing, Medizintechnik
